# Trix URL

> Free URL shortening tool with real-time analytics. Shorten long URLs into clean, trackable links and monitor every click with geographic, device, and referrer data.

Trix URL is a free web application that shortens long URLs into short, memorable links. It provides real-time click analytics including geographic location, device type, browser, operating system, and referrer tracking. Users can also generate QR codes for each shortened link.

## Features

- **URL Shortening**: Paste any long URL and get a short, clean link instantly
- **Click Analytics**: Real-time tracking of clicks with geographic data, device types, browsers, and referrers
- **QR Code Generation**: Auto-generated QR codes for every short link, downloadable as PNG
- **Link Management**: Dashboard to view, update, and delete shortened links
- **Spam Protection**: Built-in URL validation to block malicious links
- **Free to Use**: No signup required for basic shortening; free account for full analytics

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://trixurl.vercel.app/) — URL shortening tool and feature overview
- [Login](https://trixurl.vercel.app/auth/login) — Sign in to your account
- [Register](https://trixurl.vercel.app/auth/register) — Create a free account
- [Dashboard](https://trixurl.vercel.app/dashboard) — Manage links and view analytics (requires login)

## Pricing

Trix URL is free to use. No paid plans currently.
